scope: inspect whether the existing factor-graph executable can be wired to Android raw observations without an estimator rewrite

observed_contract.android_adapter: exports single-handset RINEX with GPS L1/Galileo E1 validation and optional Hatch30; it does not provide an independent base or double-difference stream
observed_contract.existing_fgo: accepts RINEX rover/base and has pseudorange, motion, Doppler/TDCP, and carrier factor switches, but the smartphone direct path is not exposed as a raw CSV adapter
observed_contract.runtime: the GTSAM-linked binary needs /home/sasaki/.local/lib in LD_LIBRARY_PATH for libmetis-gtsam.so; Eigen smoke is available after Release build

blocker: a coupled Android pseudorange/clock/quality factor adapter, observability contract, and validation are required before enabling FGO; this is materially larger than bounded wiring
